[SWS_DM_00033] Debounce timer behavior upon reported
kFailed
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04225
⌈
If the
monitor
reports
kFailed
, the DM shall set the debounce timer value to
DiagEventDebounceTimeBased.timeFailedThreshold
and process the event
as
kFinallyDefective
.
⌋
